title: GLM-5.3 NVFP4-CSF on six Sparks
evidence_scope: Research-only TP6 profile for positions 0-5 of an eight-Spark cycle, with SIRCL and NCCL off. Uses the pinned CSF serving directory with in-memory HF overrides: 66 attention heads and 2304 expert columns (384 per rank), DCP2, 32 GiB KV per rank, 1048576-token maximum sequence, eight sequences and two-token MTP. Release 2026.10.4's image admits it. Installed and served on ring8c positions 0-5 on 2026-10-14 with 135168-token context: startup checks took effect, KV pool 1,255,552 tokens, short smoke requests correct (performance/records/images/dev-20261013-dcp2prefill-status038-sircl-tp6-glm53-nvfp4-csf-tp6-ring8-20261014.md). The 1048576-token context and throughput are not measured. See the profile guide for omitted TP8-only speedups and capacity limits. Not serving-qualified.
